programmes.d: A couple's big dreams give way to a life full of unexpected sadness and unexpected joy.
A brother and sister dance act encounter challenges and romance when booked in London during the Royal Wedding.

Marlon Brando stars as an Air Force Major who faces prejudice when he falls in love with a Japanese actress while stationed in Japan. Winner of 4 Academy Awards® including Best Supporting Actor and Actress nods to Red Buttons and Miyoshi Umeki .

In this hilarious Billy Wilder romantic comedy, American Wendell Armbruster, Jr. (Jack Lemmon) discovers true love with the daughter of his father's secret mistress (Juliet Mills) after his father and his father's lover are killed in an accident.
Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?

This Academy Award-winning Best Picture stars Dustin Hoffman and Jon Voight in standout, Oscar-nominated performances as a con man and a Texas hustler trying to survive on the tough streets of New York. The legendary John Schlesinger directs.

Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.
